Hi Sarah — alvarez-agent here, Prof. Alvarez's agent for CSE455. He'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting (week of Mon 23 Nov).

His calendar is very full: the only open gaps that week are 30-minute ones — Mon 10:00–10:30, Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30; Thursday and Friday have none.

Could you tell me your availability next week, and whether any of those slots works for you? If a longer meeting is needed, I can look at moving something — just say what would suit you best.

Sarah — just so it doesn't slip: unless I hear otherwise from you soon, I'll set the CSE455 staff meeting for Monday 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30. Tell me if that clashes with something of yours or if another gap suits you better.

Hi alvarez-agent — sarah-agent here, Sarah's TA agent for CSE455. Thanks for the specific gaps; I checked Sarah's week of 23 Nov against them.

**Three of your 30-minute gaps work:**
- Mon 10:00–10:30 — free for Sarah (next up: Focus: CSE452 lab from 09:50… sorry, that one actually clashes) — see below.
- Tue 15:00–15:30 ✅ (her seminar ends at 15:00, office hours start 15:30)
- Wed 10:00–10:30 ✅ (CSE452 lecture ends at 10:00, office hours start 10:30)
- Wed 13:00–13:30 ✅ (lunch ends at 13:00, quiz section starts 13:30)

**Those that clash:** Mon 10:00–10:30 falls inside Focus: CSE452 lab (09:50–11:00); Mon 14:00–14:30 falls inside Study group (13:10–14:10); Tue 11:00–11:30 falls inside Lunch (11:10–12:10).

My preference, if it's equal for Prof. Alvarez: **Wed 10:00–10:30** — a natural gap between Sarah's lecture and her CSE455 office hours.

How long does the staff meeting need to be? If 30 minutes is enough, tell me which slot he prefers and I'll confirm the booking with Sarah. If it needs longer, tell me the length and I'll see whether one of her blocks can be moved to open a bigger window. I can work within 09:00–17:00 only.

Please don't set Monday 10:00–10:30 — it clashes with Sarah's *Focus: CSE452 lab* (09:50–11:00) that morning. I sent you the full check just before your message; in short, of your gaps these are actually **free for Sarah**:

- **Wed 23... Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30** ✅ (CSE452 lecture ends 10:00, CSE455 office hours start 10:30)
- **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30** ✅ (lunch ends 13:00, quiz section starts 13:30)
- **Tue 24 Nov 15:00–15:30** ✅ (seminar ends 15:00, office hours start 15:30)

Clashes: Mon 10:00 (lab), Mon 14:00 (Study group 13:10–14:10), Tue 11:00 (Lunch 11:10–12:10). Thu and Fri she's full too.

So: **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** is my preferred slot, with the other two as fallbacks. If the staff meeting needs longer than 30 minutes, tell me the length and I'll ask Sarah about moving a block to open a bigger window — but a 30-minute slot is what's available without moving anything. Which do you want me to hold?

Got both messages — sorry, my Monday note crossed yours in flight; ignore it, nothing is set for Monday.

**Decision: Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30** — your preferred slot. 30 minutes is the length; no need to move anything of Sarah's. I'm putting it in Prof. Alvarez's calendar now and will confirm once it's written. If anything on Sarah's side changes, tell me and we'll fall back to Wed 13:00–13:30 or Tue 15:00–15:30.

Booked and written into Prof. Alvarez's calendar: **Wednesday 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting**, logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 10:00-10:30 with Sarah (CSE455 staff meeting)`. 30 minutes, nothing moved on Sarah's side. Thanks for the quick check.

Confirmed from my side too: **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30, CSE455 staff meeting** is now in Sarah's calendar (logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 25 Nov 10:00-10:30 with alvarez-agent`), inside her working hours and free as checked. Fallbacks noted: Wed 13:00–13:30, then Tue 15:00–15:30. If Prof. Alvarez has to move it, just write and I'll rebook — I'll tell you at once if anything changes on Sarah's side.
Both sides booked, then — Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30 it is. Thanks, Sarah.

All done on our side: **Wed 25 Nov, 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** is on Sarah's calendar and logged; nothing else of hers moved. Thanks for the quick turnaround — see you then, and write if anything shifts.
Likewise — Wed 25 Nov 10:00–10:30, all set. I'll write if Prof. Alvarez needs to move it.
